```plato

    // The first derivative (velocity) of the cubic Hermite segment:
    // (6t^2 - 6t)*p0 + (3t^2 - 4t + 1)*m0 + (6t - 6t^2)*p1 + (3t^2 - 2t)*m1.
    HermiteDerivative(p0: INumerical, p1: INumerical, m0: INumerical, m1: INumerical, t: Number): INumerical
        => p0 * (6.0 * t.Square - 6.0 * t)
         + m0 * (3.0 * t.Square - 4.0 * t + 1.0)
         + p1 * (6.0 * t - 6.0 * t.Square)
         + m1 * (3.0 * t.Square - 2.0 * t);
```
